hooks.command: file=$(jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty'); case "$file" in *.ts|*.tsx) out=$(npm run typecheck --silent 2>&1); code=$?; if [ "$code" -ne 0 ]; then echo "$out" >&2; exit 2; fi ;; esac; exit 0

file=$(jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty'); case "$file" in *src/*) echo '-- arch:check (advisory only -- known false positives, see invariant-guardian for a real pass) --'; bash scripts/check-invariants.sh 2>&1 ;; esac; exit 0
